crossRefs.note: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

parallels.note: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

people.name: Beriah
people.line: Son of Asher and head of a clan

people.name: Birzaith
people.line: A son or town of Malchiel

people.name: Heber
people.line: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.

people.name: Malchiel
people.line: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.

translations.web: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
translations.bsb: The sons of Beriah: Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
translations.asv: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
